findings.finding: The new Director AIR-01–14 supplement renames/reassigns IDs and substitutes several unsupported rows. For example model AIR-04 is Nomadic Human, AIR-05 Winterfang, AIR-07 Physical Conditioning, AIR-10 Adaptive Perfection and AIR-11 Adaptive Mutation; the prose instead assigns other topics to those IDs.
findings.resolution: Keep the exact Return02 model and all 51 source identities unchanged. Render the complete actual rows, access predicates, dispositions and supplied source evidence into the Director chapter. Do not invent replacement AIR identities.

findings.finding: Both Return02 chapters instruct holding gauge zero for 60 seconds, while the preserved CF-1 plate requires 60 seconds venting positive pressure until the gauge reaches zero; initially verified zero requires no wait. New ARC17-C29 incorrectly sets gauge zero immediately on opening the vent.
findings.resolution: Use exact model CF-1 text in both chapters. Opening V invalidates readiness immediately; the normal positive-pressure vent interval remains 60 seconds. Correct C29 to block printing while that vent is in progress and reach verified zero only at t66 after its opening Action. Retain the accepted new pressReady rule unchanged.

findings.finding: ARC15-C02 formerly demonstrated completion exactly at Equinox E. Return02 replaces it with a generic batch example duplicated by new C10, losing the original equality scenario.
findings.resolution: Restore the exact original C02 equality scenario from Return01; leave new C10 as the batch example. All 78 IDs remain in the same order.

findings.finding: ARC16-C28 now narrates takeoff, later abort/return and payment but reports only six total elapsed seconds, losing the earlier explicit timing-scope qualification.
findings.resolution: Retain all actual stages, set elapsedSeconds null and provide a formula including takeoff, actual abort/return duration and actual settlement time. Record entitlement at t6 and payment only at the later real meeting. No free return or settlement is inferred.

findings.finding: The replacement Player chapter is much shorter than Return01 and omits previously stated material terms, relic boundaries, exact Equinox equality and refusal options. The Director chapter keeps stale contradictory passages above an appended correction supplement; several detailed operative fields are still missing.
findings.resolution: Preserve all original returns. Rebuild the Player chapter from its fuller Return01 text with targeted current corrections and complete model contract/press instructions. Rebuild the Director chapter from every operative field of the unchanged Return02 model in readable sections, retaining its existing schematic maps. Exact field-to-prose mapping is recorded for audit. No source facts are deleted or new mechanics added.

findings.finding: The Return02 prose introduces four mandatory vessel-start conditions while correcting the four-condition contract list. Requiring serviceable cabin air for all departures is not in the actual powered-support prerequisites and could bar an otherwise valid no-breath crew/party.
findings.resolution: Use the unchanged model actual anatomy, protection and support predicates. The four-condition enumeration belongs to contract acceptance. Do not introduce a universal cabin-air prerequisite through prose.
